title: CHRIS STASSY pres. by BOOTSHAUS
sourceDescription:
On 16th October, CHRIS STASSY plays the Bootshaus MAINFLOOR for the first time.

Known for flowing sets and an approach where the music comes first, he brings his distinctive energy to Bootshaus.
